items.title: Multiomics Characterization Identifies S1P-secreting USSHigh Skeletal Muscle Stem Cells as Essential Drivers of Niche Remodeling and Muscle Regeneration
items.abstract_or_text: Acutely induced cellular senescence is increasingly recognized as vital for tissue repair but the precise roles of senescent cells in skeletal muscle regeneration remain paradoxical. Here, using single-cell RNA sequencing and a Unified Senescence Score (USS) methodology, we identify a distinct USSHigh (USSHi) muscle stem cell (MuSC) subpopulation emerging in early phase of acute injury induced muscle regeneration. Isolation via the surface marker MHCII enables characterization of these cells as exhibiting canonical senescent-like features. Further characterization through integrated transcriptomics, proteomics, and secretomics reveals their highly pro-inflammatory secretory capacity. Moreover, lipidomic profiling uncovers that the USSHi MuSCs undergo profound sphingolipid metabolic remodeling to generate upregulated bioactive lipid Sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P). In vivo specific ablation of this subpopulation using a Pax7-CreERT; Ccl2-LSL-DTA genetic strategy significantly impaired muscle regeneration. Furthermore, spatial transcriptomics and cell-cell communication analyses revealed that USSHi MuSCs act as critical niche modulators, directing crosstalk with multiple cell types. Specifically, S1P is essential for mediating direct USSHi interaction with endothelial cells and USSLo cells to promote endothelial angiogenesis and MuSC expansion in the regenerating muscle. Crucially, exogenous S1P rescues the regenerative deficits caused by USSHi MuSC ablation. Altogether our findings define a senescent-like MuSC population emerging in acute injury induced muscle regeneration and provide definitive evidence to demonstrate the positive role of these cells in enhancing muscle repair via their robust secretory phenotypes and inter-cellular communicative capacity.
items.summary_zh: 多组学揭示分泌 S1P 的 USSHigh 骨骼肌干细胞驱动损伤后微环境重塑与再生。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 单细胞、多组学、空间分析、遗传消融与 S1P 救援共同支持该细胞亚群参与肌肉再生，但其在人类疾病中的可转化性仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 急性诱导的细胞衰老日益被认为对组织修复至关重要，但衰老细胞在骨骼肌再生中的确切作用仍存在矛盾。我们在此利用单细胞 RNA 测序和统一衰老评分（USS）方法，鉴定出一个在急性损伤诱导的肌肉再生早期出现的、独特的 USSHigh（USSHi）肌肉干细胞（MuSC）亚群。通过表面标记物 MHCII 分离后，我们表征了这些细胞具有典型的衰老样特征。进一步结合转录组学、蛋白质组学和分泌组学的表征显示，它们具有很强的促炎性分泌能力。此外，脂质组学分析发现，USSHi MuSC 发生深刻的鞘脂代谢重塑，从而产生上调的生物活性脂质 Sphingosine-1-phosphate（S1P）。利用 Pax7-CreERT; Ccl2-LSL-DTA 遗传策略在体内特异性消融该亚群，显著损害了肌肉再生。进一步地，空间转录组学和细胞间通讯分析显示，USSHi MuSC 是关键的微环境调节者，可引导其与多种细胞类型的串扰。具体而言，S1P 对介导 USSHi 与内皮细胞及 USSLo 细胞的直接相互作用至关重要，从而促进再生肌肉中的内皮血管生成和 MuSC 扩增。关键的是，外源性 S1P 可挽救由 USSHi MuSC 消融造成的再生缺陷。总之，我们的发现界定了一个在急性损伤诱导的肌肉再生中出现的衰老样 MuSC 群体，并提供了确切证据，表明这些细胞可通过其强大的分泌表型和细胞间通讯能力促进肌肉修复。

items.title: Genomic Engineering of Gene Dosage: A Generalizable Framework for Modeling Haploinsufficiency-Mediated Human Disorders through Splicing Modulation
items.abstract_or_text: Heterozygous loss-of-function variants causing gene dosage reduction underlie many human genetic disorders, yet preclinical mouse models frequently fail to recapitulate human disease phenotypes due to post-translational compensation. Here, we present a generalizable framework to modulate gene dosage by alternative splicing via genome editing. By shifting proportions of transcripts toward nonsense-mediated decay, this approach enables precise titration of functional protein levels. Applying this concept to Mybpc3, we combined hypomorphic splice-altering alleles to overwhelm post-translational buffering in mice, successfully reproducing hallmark structural and functional features of human hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Extending this concept, we engineered a portable Modulated Alternative Splice Cassette (MASC) inserted into Dsp, yielding patient-level protein reductions and characteristic arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy pathologies, including subepicardial cardiac fibrosis and immune cell infiltration. These novel haploinsufficient models of Mybpc3 hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and Dsp arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy will critically enable mechanistic and therapeutic testing under protein stoichiometry conditions that closely replicate the patient disorders. Finally, systematic in silico predictive modeling across 645 human haploinsufficiency-associated genes demonstrated the generalizability of MASC insertion effects on splicing across diverse tissue types. Notably, the framework developed here leaves endogenous gene expression regulatory logic intact, allowing these models to be used to develop and validate therapeutic approaches that target transcription. Overall, this strategy provides a scalable roadmap for engineering high-fidelity animal models for human diseases caused by haploinsufficiency.
items.summary_zh: 利用可调控可变剪接盒构建更接近人类单倍剂量不足疾病的动物模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究在两种心肌病小鼠中展示了可调的内源蛋白剂量，并以 645 个疾病相关基因的计算分析支持其可推广性。
items.abstract_zh: 由杂合性功能缺失变异引起的基因剂量降低是许多人类遗传病的基础；然而，由于翻译后补偿，临床前小鼠模型常常无法重现人类疾病表型。我们在此提出一种通用框架，通过基因组编辑调控可变剪接来调节基因剂量。通过使更多转录本转向无义介导的降解，该方法能够精确滴定功能性蛋白水平。将这一概念应用于 Mybpc3 时，我们在小鼠中组合低表达的剪接改变等位基因，以克服翻译后缓冲，成功重现了人类肥厚型心肌病的标志性结构和功能特征。进一步地，我们设计了插入 Dsp 的便携式 Modulated Alternative Splice Cassette（MASC），获得患者水平的蛋白降低以及特征性的致心律失常性心肌病病理，包括心外膜下心脏纤维化和免疫细胞浸润。这些 Mybpc3 肥厚型心肌病和 Dsp 致心律失常性心肌病的新型单倍剂量不足模型，将在更贴近患者疾病的蛋白质化学计量条件下，关键性地支持机制和治疗测试。最后，针对 645 个与人类单倍剂量不足相关基因的系统性 in silico 预测建模表明，MASC 插入对多种组织类型中剪接效应具有可推广性。值得注意的是，此处开发的框架保留了内源基因表达的调控逻辑，使这些模型可用于开发和验证靶向转录的治疗方法。总体而言，该策略为构建由单倍剂量不足导致的人类疾病高保真动物模型提供了一条可扩展路线图。
items.author_line: Smith ED, Meisner JK, Bullard A, Ward CB, Licata J, Smith C, Kelly CM, LaRochelle ZT, Friedline S, Renberg A, Yucius R, Lange J, Hughes ED, Saunders TL, Freeman ZT, Tsan Y, Previs MJ, Kitzman JO, Helms AS

items.title: Proinflammatory cytokines promote tau aggregation by inducing cleavage in human Alzheimer’s disease
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Neuroinflammation and tau aggregation are hallmarks of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet the mechanistic link between them remains unknown. Analyzing a cohort of 46 AD and 40 control subjects using mass spectrometry-based proteomics, we identified a strong correlation between upregulation of the cytokine-induced antigen-presentation pathway and site-specific tau cleavage. This cleavage enriches the microtubule-binding repeat (MTBR) domain in AD tau aggregates; furthermore, synthetic MTBR fragments recapitulate tau aggregation both in vitro and in vivo. Our data show that the immunoproteasome (IP) colocalizes with tau aggregates in human AD neurons and drives the observed cleavage pattern. Proinflammatory cytokines reproduced AD-like tau cleavage and puncta formation in HEK293T cells expressing 0N4R tau, the hTau knock-in mouse, and human iPSC-derived neurons (iNeurons). IP knockdown via siRNA reduced tau-positive inclusion and upstream JAK/STAT pathway inhibition across model systems, including iNeurons, effectively abrogated cleavage and tau aggregation. These findings identify an inflammation-responsive pathway that promotes tau pathology and provide a mechanistic framework and potential therapeutic entry point for AD and potentially other tauopathies.
items.summary_zh: 炎性细胞因子经免疫蛋白酶体相关 tau 切割促进阿尔茨海默病 tau 聚集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 人脑队列、细胞、iPSC 神经元和 hTau 小鼠中的一致结果提出可检验的炎症—tau 病理联系，但治疗效应尚未在人类临床试验中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 神经炎症和 tau 聚集是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的标志，但二者之间的机制联系尚不清楚。我们利用基于质谱的蛋白质组学分析了由 46 名 AD 受试者和 40 名对照受试者组成的队列，鉴定出细胞因子诱导的抗原呈递通路上调与位点特异性 tau 切割之间存在强相关。这种切割使微管结合重复区（MTBR）结构域在 AD tau 聚集体中富集；此外，合成 MTBR 片段可在体外和体内重现 tau 聚集。我们的数据表明，免疫蛋白酶体（IP）与人类 AD 神经元中的 tau 聚集体共定位，并驱动所观察到的切割模式。促炎性细胞因子在表达 0N4R tau 的 HEK293T 细胞、hTau knock-in 小鼠和人 iPSC 来源神经元（iNeurons）中重现了 AD 样 tau 切割和斑点形成。通过 siRNA 敲低 IP 可减少 tau 阳性包涵体，而在包括 iNeurons 在内的模型系统中抑制上游 JAK/STAT 通路，可有效阻断切割和 tau 聚集。这些发现鉴定出一条促进 tau 病理的炎症应答通路，并为 AD 及可能的其他 tau 蛋白病提供了机制框架和潜在治疗切入点。

items.title: Biomarker-Targeted O6-Guanine Alkylation Potentiates ATR Inhibitor Response in De Novo and Relapsed/Refractory AML
items.abstract_or_text: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) remains limited by high relapse rates and a scarcity of biomarker-directed therapies, underscoring the need to identify actionable vulnerabilities and mechanisms of therapeutic resistance. O6-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT), a DNA repair enzyme that directly reverses mutagenic O6-alkylguanine lesions, is epigenetically silenced in multiple cancers. Although MGMT silencing is predictive of temozolomide (TMZ) response in glioblastoma with significant survival advantage, prior clinical trials of TMZ in AML have shown only modest responses. Therefore, the prevalence and therapeutic relevance of MGMT silencing, as well as genetic factors that modify its therapeutic response in AML, remain to be comprehensively investigated. Here, we first profiled MGMT status across a diverse cohort of 23 de novo and 16 relapsed/refractory (R/R) primary AMLs using an integrated analysis of MGMT mRNA expression, promoter methylation, and protein expression. We found that approximately 25-30% of AMLs harbor MGMT silencing, in contrast to consistent MGMT expression in healthy CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells. We further identified frequent loss of mismatch repair (MMR) proteins in these AML cohorts, a known resistance mechanism against TMZ in glioblastoma. Using CRISPR knockout screening and genetically engineered AML models, we found that MMR loss also drives both upfront and acquired TMZ resistance in MGMT-silenced AML. These findings identify MMR deficiency as an important and previously underappreciated genetic contributor to the modest responses observed in prior trials of TMZ in AML. To therapeutically exploit MGMT silencing while bypassing genetic determinants of resistance, including MMR deficiency, we evaluated clinically and preclinically characterized MGMT-dependent DNA-alkylating agents and identified a fluoroethylating analog of TMZ, N3-(2-fluoroethyl) imidazotetrazine (KL50), with pronounced and selective activity in MGMT-silenced AML. KL50 retained antileukemic activity irrespective of MMR status, significantly prolonging survival in humanized MISTRG6 mice harboring primary AML patient-derived xenografts. Mechanistically, KL50 induced DNA damage through the time-dependent formation of interstrand DNA crosslinks, bypassing MMR dependence and triggering a replication stress response dominated by ATR signaling. Pharmacologic ATR inhibition synergized with KL50, producing marked antileukemic activity and significantly extending survival across AML models without compromising hematologic safety. Together, these findings establish MGMT silencing as a prevalent and therapeutically actionable biomarker in AML, define MMR status as a key determinant of TMZ response in AML but not KL50 sensitivity, and provide a translational rationale for combining low-dose O6-fluoroethylating imidazotetrazines with ATR inhibitors to target both de novo and R/R AML across diverse genetic backgrounds.
items.summary_zh: 以 MGMT 沉默为标志物，探索 KL50 与 ATR 抑制剂联用治疗 AML。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究结合原代 AML、CRISPR 筛选、工程模型和患者来源异种移植，提出 MMR 状态与 MGMT 沉默可用于分层；结论仍属临床前证据。
items.abstract_zh: 急性髓系白血病（AML）仍受限于高复发率和缺乏生物标志物导向治疗，这凸显了识别可干预脆弱性及治疗耐药机制的必要性。O6-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase（MGMT）是一种可直接逆转致突变性 O6-烷基鸟嘌呤损伤的 DNA 修复酶，在多种癌症中发生表观遗传沉默。虽然在胶质母细胞瘤中 MGMT 沉默可预测替莫唑胺（TMZ）反应并带来显著生存获益，但既往 TMZ 用于 AML 的临床试验仅显示中等反应。因此，AML 中 MGMT 沉默的流行程度和治疗相关性，以及改变其治疗反应的遗传因素，仍有待全面研究。我们首先通过整合 MGMT mRNA 表达、启动子甲基化和蛋白表达，分析了由 23 例初发及 16 例复发/难治（R/R）原代 AML 构成的多样化队列中的 MGMT 状态。我们发现，约 25–30% 的 AML 存在 MGMT 沉默，而健康 CD34+ 造血干细胞和祖细胞中 MGMT 表达稳定。我们还在这些 AML 队列中鉴定出错配修复（MMR）蛋白的频繁缺失；这已知是胶质母细胞瘤对 TMZ 耐药的机制。利用 CRISPR 敲除筛选和基因工程 AML 模型，我们发现 MMR 缺失同样会驱动 MGMT 沉默 AML 对 TMZ 的初始和获得性耐药。这些结果确定 MMR 缺陷是此前 AML 中 TMZ 反应有限的一个重要且曾被低估的遗传因素。为利用 MGMT 沉默、同时绕过包括 MMR 缺陷在内的耐药遗传决定因素，我们评估了具有临床和临床前特征的 MGMT 依赖性 DNA 烷化剂，并鉴定出 TMZ 的氟乙基化类似物 N3-(2-fluoroethyl) imidazotetrazine（KL50），其对 MGMT 沉默 AML 具有显著且选择性的活性。无论 MMR 状态如何，KL50 均保留抗白血病活性，并在植入原代 AML 患者来源异种移植物的人源化 MISTRG6 小鼠中显著延长生存期。从机制上看，KL50 通过随时间形成 DNA 链间交联诱导 DNA 损伤，绕过 MMR 依赖性并触发以 ATR 信号为主导的复制压力反应。药理性 ATR 抑制与 KL50 协同，在不损害造血安全性的情况下，在多种 AML 模型中产生显著抗白血病活性并显著延长生存期。综上，这些发现确立了 MGMT 沉默是 AML 中常见且可治疗干预的生物标志物，界定了 MMR 状态是 AML 对 TMZ 反应、但非对 KL50 敏感性的关键决定因素，并为将低剂量 O6-fluoroethylating imidazotetrazines 与 ATR 抑制剂联用以靶向不同遗传背景下初发和 R/R AML 提供了转化依据。
items.author_line: Bhardwaj P, Baassiri A, Sundaram RK, Friedman S, Elia J, VanOudenhove J, Heer C, Kiwan A, Matthews M, Gueble S, Halene S, Bindra R

items.title: Generative Neuromorphic Programming of Mammalian Cells
items.abstract_or_text: Cells make decisions through densely interconnected regulatory networks that compute graded, analog responses. Synthetic biology has made cells programmable, but the field's dominant abstractions poorly match the analog nature of cells. Designing analog circuits that work in cells is challenging: predicting how components combine remains difficult, and the vast combinatorial space of parts, weights and topologies exceeds what experiments can explore. Here we establish generative programming of mammalian cells through a neuromorphic framework that compiles desired behavior into DNA. Composable regulatory devices built from RNA-targeting endoribonucleases (ERNs) supply signed weights and nonlinear activation, enabling multi-layer circuits with diverse multi-input analog responses. To predict and design such circuits, we develop biomorphic neural networks (BMNs): a compositional architecture that mirrors biological interactions, in which each basic process (transcription, translation, cleavage) is captured by a reusable neural block learned from the behavior of whole circuits that contain it. Recomposed into architectures absent from training, these models predict responses with errors often comparable to variability between experimental repeats. Inverting this process, our software package, the biocompiler, jointly optimizes topology, parts, and weights to realize specified target behaviors. Challenged with three target behaviors, the biocompiler proposed three previously unseen architectures; we built all three, and each reproduced its target behavior in mammalian cells in a single design pass without manual tuning. Generative neuromorphic programming thus offers a systematic route to engineering the analog computation native to living cells.
items.summary_zh: 用仿生神经网络和 biocompiler 实现哺乳动物细胞模拟计算回路的生成式设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型对未见回路的预测接近实验重复间变异，并在三项目标行为中一次设计成功，展示了可检验的细胞程序化新范式。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞通过高度互连的调控网络作出决策，这些网络计算连续的、模拟式反应。合成生物学已使细胞可编程，但该领域的主导性抽象与细胞的模拟本性并不匹配。设计能在细胞中工作的模拟电路颇具挑战：难以预测组分如何组合，而部件、权重和拓扑结构的巨大组合空间超出实验所能探索的范围。我们在此通过一种将期望行为编译为 DNA 的神经形态框架，建立了哺乳动物细胞的生成式编程。由靶向 RNA 的内切核糖核酸酶（ERNs）构成的可组合调控器件提供有符号权重和非线性激活，从而实现具有多样多输入模拟反应的多层电路。为预测和设计这类电路，我们开发了仿生神经网络（BMNs）：一种映照生物相互作用的组合式架构，其中每一项基本过程（转录、翻译、切割）均由从含有该过程的完整电路行为中学习得到的可复用神经模块捕捉。将其重新组合为训练中未出现的架构时，这些模型的响应预测误差通常可与实验重复之间的变异相当。反向利用该过程，我们的软件包 biocompiler 联合优化拓扑、部件和权重，以实现指定目标行为。在三种目标行为的挑战中，biocompiler 提出了三种此前未见的架构；我们构建了全部三种，它们均在一次设计过程中、无需人工调参便在哺乳动物细胞中重现了目标行为。因此，生成式神经形态编程为工程化生命细胞固有的模拟计算提供了一条系统路线。
items.author_line: Disset J, Van De Mark C, Wachter GK, Kuo S, Moorman A, Xu W, Palanques Tost E, Buritica Monroy A, Belta C, Weiss R

items.title: DeepSCENIC: transfer learning from sequence-to-function models enables causal gene regulatory network inference
items.abstract_or_text: Sequence-to-function (S2F) deep learning models have become an important aid to decipher the genomic cis-regulatory code. However, current S2F models do not take the cellular trans-environment of transcription factors (TF) into account. Conversely, methods for gene regulatory network (GRN) inference often rely on heuristics or simple position weight matrices (PWMs), without exploiting the combinatorial grammar of genomic enhancers. Here, we present DeepSCENIC, a deep learning framework that enables causal GRN inference by performing transfer learning from S2F models to single-cell multiome atlases. We first test and validate DeepSCENIC on ENCODE cell lines, demonstrating that the framework accurately predicts single-cell gene expression and chromatin accessibility by leveraging pretrained S2F models like Enformer and Borzoi. We show that DeepSCENIC recovers TF-region (TF-RE) interactions with high fidelity, and captures de novo TF binding motifs without prior PWM knowledge. The model improves enhancer-gene associations (RE-TG) over correlation-based baselines when benchmarked against large-scale CRISPRi screens. After training a DeepSCENIC model, it enables the prediction of perturbation effects during cell state changes by acting as a mechanistic simulator. In a melanoma cell line atlas, the model accurately recapitulates the transcriptional shift from melanocytic to mesenchymal states, and predicted knock-down effects show high concordance with experimental time series data. Finally, we use DeepSCENIC to identify mouse-human cortex conserved GRNs, finding high cross-species concordance in TF activity programs across matched neuronal subclasses and validating top-ranked enhancers against experimental reporter assays. By unifying S2F enhancer representations with single-cell multiomics, DeepSCENIC provides a new paradigm for jointly modeling and simulating cis-sequence and trans-cellular perturbations.
items.summary_zh: DeepSCENIC 将 sequence-to-function 模型迁移至单细胞多组学，用于因果基因调控网络推断与扰动预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其结果由 ENCODE、CRISPRi、时间序列和报告基因实验交叉支持，连接了顺式序列表示与细胞状态层面的调控模拟。
items.abstract_zh: sequence-to-function（S2F）深度学习模型已成为解析基因组顺式调控密码的重要助力。然而，现有 S2F 模型未将转录因子（TF）的细胞反式环境纳入考虑。相反，基因调控网络（GRN）推断方法常依赖启发式规则或简单的位置权重矩阵（PWMs），而未利用基因组增强子的组合语法。我们在此提出 DeepSCENIC，这是一个通过将 S2F 模型迁移学习至单细胞多组学图谱而实现因果 GRN 推断的深度学习框架。我们首先在 ENCODE 细胞系上测试并验证 DeepSCENIC，证明该框架可借助 Enformer 和 Borzoi 等预训练 S2F 模型准确预测单细胞基因表达和染色质可及性。我们表明，DeepSCENIC 能以高保真度恢复 TF-region（TF-RE）相互作用，并在无需预先了解 PWM 的情况下捕获 de novo TF 结合基序。以大规模 CRISPRi 筛选为基准时，该模型相较于基于相关性的基线方法改进了 enhancer-gene（RE-TG）关联。训练 DeepSCENIC 模型后，它可作为机制模拟器预测细胞状态变化期间的扰动效应。在黑色素瘤细胞系图谱中，该模型准确重现了从黑色素细胞样状态到间质样状态的转录转变，且预测的 knock-down 效应与实验时间序列数据高度一致。最后，我们利用 DeepSCENIC 鉴定小鼠—人类皮层保守 GRN，发现匹配神经元亚类间 TF 活性程序具有很高的跨物种一致性，并通过实验报告基因检测验证了排名靠前的增强子。通过统一 S2F 增强子表征与单细胞多组学，DeepSCENIC 为联合建模和模拟顺式序列及反式细胞扰动提供了一种新范式。
items.author_line: Partel G, De Winter S, Konstantakos V, Blaauw CH, Aerts S

items.title: Optimization of a Human Anti-polio Monoclonal Antibody as a Potential Therapeutic Modality
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Vaccines have been an essential tool in bringing the world close to polio eradication, with over 99.9 percent of the global population free of poliovirus. No antiviral drugs or monoclonal antibody products, however, are currently licensed for treatment of polio. We previously isolated a human monoclonal antibody (9H2) with potent neutralizing activity against all three poliovirus serotypes. To advance 9H2 as a therapeutic candidate, we optimized its sequence to extend serum half-life and improve manufacturability. Methods. A Multi-Attribute Method under stress conditions identified post-translational modification sites, and Abacus (Trademark) ranked sequence liabilities. Six amino acid substitutions were introduced into the variable regions, generating 23 combinatorial variants. Codon-optimized genes were synthesized and engineered into a human immunoglobulin G1 backbone containing crystallizable fragment (Fc) mutations (M428L/N434S) to extend serum half-life. Constructs were transfected into CHO K1 cells to generate stable pools in 24 well plates. Protein A purified antibodies were characterized using biophysical assays and an in vitro poliovirus neutralization assay. Results. All variants retained high in vitro neutralizing activity against poliovirus. A lead candidate was selected based on integrated assessment of biophysical properties across eight assays and expression yield. Conclusions. Structure-guided engineering and experimental evaluation enabled optimization of the 9H2 antibody sequence and identification of a lead candidate suitable for clinical manufacturing as a potential anti-poliovirus immunotherapeutic agent.
items.summary_zh: 对广谱中和抗脊髓灰质炎病毒人源单抗 9H2 进行序列和可制造性优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以多项生物物理测定和体外中和实验筛出先导分子，具有转化价值，但尚无动物功效或人体临床结果。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：疫苗是使全球接近消灭脊髓灰质炎的关键工具，全球超过 99.9% 的人口已免于脊髓灰质炎病毒。然而，目前尚无获批用于治疗脊髓灰质炎的抗病毒药物或单克隆抗体产品。我们此前分离出一株人源单克隆抗体（9H2），其对全部三种脊髓灰质炎病毒血清型均具有强效中和活性。为将 9H2 推进为治疗候选物，我们优化了其序列以延长血清半衰期并改善可制造性。方法：应激条件下的 Multi-Attribute Method 鉴定了翻译后修饰位点，Abacus（Trademark）对序列风险位点进行排序。在可变区引入六个氨基酸替换，生成 23 个组合变体。合成密码子优化基因，并将其构建入含有可延长血清半衰期的 crystallizable fragment（Fc）突变（M428L/N434S）的人 immunoglobulin G1 骨架中。将构建体转染 CHO K1 细胞，在 24 孔板中生成稳定细胞池。利用 Protein A 纯化的抗体通过生物物理测定和体外脊髓灰质炎病毒中和测定进行表征。结果：所有变体均保留了对脊髓灰质炎病毒的高体外中和活性。基于对八项测定的生物物理性质和表达产量的综合评估，选定了一种先导候选物。结论：结构指导的工程化和实验评估实现了 9H2 抗体序列的优化，并鉴定出适于临床生产、可作为潜在抗脊髓灰质炎病毒免疫治疗物的先导候选物。
items.author_line: Lee S, Siska C, D'Angelo I, Kouiavskaia D, Mahmood K

items.title: Gravlax: an annotation-independent molecular evidence archive for single-cell RNA-seq
items.abstract_or_text: A cell-by-gene count matrix is the artifact of a single-cell RNA-seq experiment that is most often stored, shared, and reanalyzed. It is the output of a computation whose inputs are the sequenced molecules and a gene annotation, and while the molecules never change, the annotation is revised continually. Once the matrix has been produced, the evidence behind it can no longer be reinterpreted. Recovering that evidence means returning to raw reads or alignments that are large, costly to process, and frequently unavailable. We ask whether a concise representation of the molecules themselves can be extracted once and reused indefinitely, to quantify under any future annotation, to query and discover features that no annotation yet describes, and to pool evidence across cells and samples. Our starting observation is that the procedures that turn alignments into counts, gene assignment and UMI collapse, never read most of what an alignment file contains. They consume relations among molecules such as shared genomic geometry, shared placements, barcode identity, and the equality or near-equality of UMIs. We show that these relations form a statistic that is sufficient for such consumers, and we design a compact, seekable, content-authenticated archive that stores them while deferring every annotation-dependent decision to analysis time. Archives compose into content-addressed collections that route cohort queries to the molecules that can answer them without copying molecules. We implement these ideas in a tool called gravlax. Across four human 10x 3′ datasets, gravlax archives require 11—18 bits per read and are 9.0—12.7× smaller than tag-preserving CRAM. Count matrices replayed from an archive deviate from direct STARsolo quantification by 0.24—0.75% of normalized UMI mass, whereas changing GENCODE v32 to v49 moves 2.12—4.64%, and quantification replay is 34—82× faster than STARsolo at matched thread budgets. A federated index over eight archives occupies 2.96% of their size, answers a 96-query junction panel 2.59× faster than the archives alone, and screens the cohort genome-wide for unannotated splice events that recur across donors in just 9 seconds. Because the molecules are retained, the archives also answer questions the matrix has discarded. An analysis of four peripheral-blood archives recovers a validated FYB1 immune-cell splicing switch, a cross-fitted fragment model appropriate for 3′ chemistry reveals an eight-donor shift in NTRK2 terminal-isoform usage from astrocyte and neural-stem-cell populations to mature neurons, and pooling evidence across cells within the context of an expectation-maximization algorithm recovers 75—98% of withheld multi-gene molecule labels. Gravlax is open source, implemented in Rust, licensed under the BSD 3-clause license, and available at https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/gravlax.
items.summary_zh: Gravlax 将单细胞测序分子证据压缩为可随未来注释重放的开放档案。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具保留计数矩阵丢失的分子关系，并在四个人类 10x 数据集上报告压缩、重放速度和新剪接事件检索优势，且已开源。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞×基因计数矩阵是单细胞 RNA-seq 实验中最常被存储、共享和再分析的产物。它是一个计算的输出，其输入是被测序的分子和基因注释；分子永不改变，而注释却持续修订。一旦矩阵生成，其背后的证据便无法再被重新解释。恢复这些证据意味着回到原始 reads 或比对结果；它们体量庞大、处理成本高，并且常常不可获得。我们探讨能否一次性提取分子本身的简洁表示并无限期复用：可依任意未来注释进行定量、查询和发现尚无任何注释描述的特征，以及在细胞和样本间汇集证据。我们的出发观察是，将比对结果转为计数的过程——基因分配和 UMI 合并——从不读取比对文件所含的大部分信息。它们使用分子之间的关系，例如共享的基因组几何、共享的定位、条形码身份以及 UMI 的相等或近似相等。我们表明，这些关系构成了对这类处理而言充分的统计量，并设计了一种紧凑、可检索、经内容认证的档案：它存储这些关系，同时将每一项依赖注释的决定推迟至分析时作出。档案可组合为内容寻址的集合，使队列查询可路由至能够回答问题的分子，而无需复制分子。我们将这些思想实现在名为 gravlax 的工具中。在四个 10x 3′ 人类数据集上，gravlax 档案每个 read 需要 11–18 bits，比保留标签的 CRAM 小 9.0–12.7 倍。从档案重放的计数矩阵与直接 STARsolo 定量相比，在归一化 UMI 质量上偏离 0.24–0.75%，而将 GENCODE v32 改为 v49 会导致 2.12–4.64% 的变化；在匹配线程预算下，重放定量比 STARsolo 快 34–82 倍。由八个档案构成的联邦索引占其大小的 2.96%，对一个含 96 个查询的剪接位点面板的回答速度比单独档案快 2.59 倍，并可在仅 9 秒内于全基因组范围筛查队列中跨供体重复出现的未注释剪接事件。由于分子被保留，档案还可回答矩阵已丢弃的问题。对四个外周血档案的分析恢复了一个经验证的 FYB1 免疫细胞剪接转换；适用于 3′ 化学方法的交叉拟合片段模型揭示，在八名供体中，NTRK2 末端异构体使用从星形胶质细胞和神经干细胞群体转变至成熟神经元；并且在期望最大化算法的背景下汇集细胞间证据，可恢复 75–98% 被保留的多基因分子标签。Gravlax 为开源软件，以 Rust 实现，采用 BSD 3-clause license，并可在 https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/gravlax 获取。

items.title: Benchmarking open-source automated thigh muscle MRI segmentation algorithms
items.abstract_or_text: Automatic segmentation of medical images could accelerate clinical and research workflows, yet existing tools are rarely compared independently on shared benchmarks, making it difficult to assess genuine progress. This is particularly consequential for limb muscle segmentation in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), which underpins volumetric analysis, radiomics, and fat fraction quantification used as biomarkers in neuromuscular disease -- applications where segmentation errors can directly affect interpretation. Despite the availability of multiple open-source segmentation tools spanning diverse architectures, no independent head-to-head comparison has appeared in the literature. We address this gap by evaluating eight tools, six of which run independently, and the other two of which are meant to be auxiliary algorithms once muscles have been somehow initially labeled. We evaluated these tools on three-dimensional MRI volumes across three base datasets and then later against derived datasets, assessing both quantitative metrics and qualitative usability. Our results reveal substantial performance variation across methods and datasets, with many methods showing reduced accuracy on pathological cases. Domain-specific models trained on large datasets consistently outperformed foundation models and newer general-purpose architectures. Our results reveal practical trade-offs between accuracy, generalizability, and ease of use that are critical for clinical adoption, while raising concerns for deployment on underrepresented populations and pathologies.
items.summary_zh: 独立比较开源大腿肌肉 MRI 自动分割算法的准确性、泛化性与可用性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 八种工具在共享 3D MRI 数据上的头对头比较指出病理病例和代表性不足人群的部署风险，为临床应用提供实际参照。
items.abstract_zh: 医学图像自动分割可加速临床和研究流程，但现有工具很少在共享基准上得到独立比较，因而难以评估真正的进展。这对于 MRI 中肢体肌肉分割尤其重要；该任务支撑用于神经肌肉疾病生物标志物的体积分析、影像组学和脂肪分数定量，而分割错误可直接影响解释。尽管已有多种架构各异的开源分割工具，文献中尚未出现独立的头对头比较。我们通过评估八种工具来填补这一空白，其中六种可独立运行，另两种则是在肌肉以某种方式完成初始标注后使用的辅助算法。我们先在来自三个基础数据集的三维 MRI 体积上评估这些工具，随后又在派生数据集上评估，并考察定量指标和定性可用性。结果显示，不同方法和数据集之间的性能存在显著差异，许多方法在病理病例上的准确性降低。在大数据集上训练的领域特异性模型始终优于基础模型和较新的通用架构。我们的结果揭示了准确性、泛化性与易用性之间对临床采纳至关重要的实际权衡，同时也引发了对在代表性不足人群和病理上部署的担忧。

items.title: A Comparative Benchmark of Biomedical Language Models for Concept Normalization from Real-World Text
items.abstract_or_text: Patient-reported and clinically documented narratives often contain informal, fragmented and linguistically heterogeneous expressions, complicating medical concept normalization (MCN) and frequently necessitating pre-processing before terminology mapping. Despite rapid advances in biomedical language modeling, the comparative utility of representation models for MCN and their integration with instruction-tuned LLMs in automated normalization workflows remain underexplored. In this study, we systematically benchmarked 15 general, biomedical and clinical transformer-based representation models together with 12 instruction-tuned LLMs across 12,713 instances from five established datasets: TAC2017_ADR, TwADR-L, TwiMed, CADEC and SMM4H2017. Representation models were evaluated using embedding-based semantic retrieval, whereas instruction-tuned LLMs were assessed as upstream text-correction modules. SapBERT achieved the highest Top-5 accuracy among representation models, reaching 63.8% for SNOMED CT and 58.0% for MedDRA without correction. Qwen 2 Instruct was selected as the preferred corrector on the basis of its favorable balance between Top-1 normalization performance and computational efficiency relative to substantially larger models, including Llama 3.1 Instruct (70B). Incorporation of Qwen 2 Instruct increased Top-5 accuracy to 69.4% for SNOMED CT and 63.2% for MedDRA. The resulting framework accepts heterogeneous short medical expressions without manual input pre-processing and automatically performs text refinement, semantic retrieval and terminology mapping to standardized concepts and vocabulary codes. These findings establish a benchmark-guided, scalable framework for automated medical terminology standardization.
items.summary_zh: 在真实世界医学文本上比较表征模型与指令微调 LLM 的医学概念标准化能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖五个既有数据集的 12,713 个实例；结果支持将 Qwen 2 Instruct 用作上游文本校正模块，但不等同于真实临床工作流的前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 患者报告和临床记录的叙述常含有非正式、碎片化且语言异质的表达，使医学概念标准化（MCN）变得复杂，并经常需要在术语映射前进行预处理。尽管生物医学语言建模进展迅速，表征模型用于 MCN 的比较效用，以及它们与指令微调 LLM 在自动化标准化工作流中的整合，仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们在来自五个既有数据集——TAC2017_ADR、TwADR-L、TwiMed、CADEC 和 SMM4H2017——的 12,713 个实例上，系统性地基准测试了 15 个通用、生物医学和临床 transformer 表征模型以及 12 个指令微调 LLM。表征模型通过基于嵌入的语义检索进行评估，而指令微调 LLM 则作为上游文本校正模块接受评估。在未经校正时，SapBERT 在表征模型中取得最高 Top-5 准确率：SNOMED CT 为 63.8%，MedDRA 为 58.0%。基于与包括 Llama 3.1 Instruct（70B）在内的显著更大模型相比，其 Top-1 标准化性能与计算效率之间的有利平衡，Qwen 2 Instruct 被选为首选校正器。纳入 Qwen 2 Instruct 后，SNOMED CT 的 Top-5 准确率提高至 69.4%，MedDRA 提高至 63.2%。所得框架无需人工输入预处理即可接收异质的短医学表达，并自动执行文本细化、语义检索以及向标准化概念和词汇代码的术语映射。这些发现建立了一个由基准测试指导、可扩展的自动化医学术语标准化框架。
items.author_line: Verma A, Abhijay, Vangani M, Prakash S, Chaudhary K

items.title: Beyond Accuracy: Benchmarking the Reproducibility and Robustness of Single-Cell Embeddings
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Single-cell representation models are evaluated almost exclusively on predictive accuracy, leaving their reproducibility largely unquantified. An implicit assumption fills the gap: that classical and linear methods are reproducible while deep and stochastic ones are not, so that reproducibility can be inferred from a method’s family. We test that assumption directly. We present BioBench, an open-source framework that measures how much a model’s learned representation changes when only an incidental detail is altered—the random seed or a defensible preprocessing perturbation—under a single standardized, provenance-tracked pipeline. We introduce the Biological Stability Score (BSS), a neighborhood-preservation metric that quantifies representational stability on a model-agnostic basis, and apply it to five CPU-feasible methods spanning classical and deep families (PCA, truncated SVD, ICA, NMF, and scVI) across three human datasets. Re-run reproducibility forms a wide continuum, from perfectly deterministic (PCA, BSS = 1.000) through near-deterministic (ICA, 0.874–1.000) and strongly dataset-dependent (TruncatedSVD, 0.380–0.855) to substantially irreproducible (NMF, 0.325–0.550; scVI, 0.258–0.526). This continuum is not predicted by model class: a classical linear method (NMF) is as irreproducible as a deep generative one (scVI). A matched-pair comparison isolates the cause: PCA and TruncatedSVD compute near-identical linear representations of near-identical downstream quality (Tabula Sapiens ARI 0.587 versus 0.585, identical cell-type accuracy 0.772) yet differ in re-run stability by up to 0.62 BSS, a gap attributable to the solver alone—deterministic full SVD versus a randomized solver. Reproducibility is therefore a property of the algorithm and its solver rather than of linearity or model sophistication, and cannot be inferred from a method’s family. We argue that every single-cell benchmark should report a per-dataset re-run noise floor alongside accuracy, and release BioBench as standardized infrastructure for doing so.
items.summary_zh: BioBench 量化单细胞嵌入在随机种子和预处理扰动下的可重复性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开放框架显示稳定性不能由模型类别推断，并给出可在单细胞基准中报告的 Biological Stability Score。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞表征模型几乎只按预测准确性评估，其可重复性在很大程度上未被量化。一个隐含假设填补了这一空白：经典和线性方法具有可重复性，而深度和随机方法不具有可重复性，因此可从方法家族推断可重复性。我们直接检验了这一假设。我们提出 BioBench，这是一个开源框架：在统一、经过来源追踪的流水线下，它度量当仅改变一个附带细节——随机种子或合理的预处理扰动——时模型所学表征的变化程度。我们引入 Biological Stability Score（BSS），一种在模型无关基础上量化表征稳定性的邻域保持指标，并将其应用于三个人人类数据集上的五种 CPU 可行方法，涵盖经典和深度家族（PCA、truncated SVD、ICA、NMF 和 scVI）。重复运行的可重复性呈现宽广连续谱：从完全确定性的方法（PCA，BSS = 1.000），到近确定性的方法（ICA，0.874–1.000）和强烈依赖数据集的方法（TruncatedSVD，0.380–0.855），再到实质上不可重复的方法（NMF，0.325–0.550；scVI，0.258–0.526）。这一连续谱不能由模型类别预测：经典线性方法 NMF 与深度生成方法 scVI 一样不可重复。一项匹配对比较分离出了原因：PCA 和 TruncatedSVD 计算出的线性表征几乎相同、下游质量也几乎相同（Tabula Sapiens ARI 为 0.587 对 0.585，细胞类型准确率同为 0.772），但二者的重复运行稳定性最多相差 0.62 BSS；这一差距归因于求解器本身——确定性的 full SVD 与随机化求解器。因而，可重复性是算法及其求解器的属性，而非线性或模型复杂度的属性，不能从方法家族推断。我们主张，每项单细胞基准测试都应在准确率之外报告逐数据集的重复运行噪声下限，并发布 BioBench 作为实现此目标的标准化基础设施。

items.title: PathEdit: Diagnostic-Preserving Counterfactual Medical Image Editing through State-Factorized Generative Intervention
items.abstract_or_text: Counterfactual medical images are useful only when a requested clinical change is introduced without silently altering patient characteristics that should remain fixed. Existing diffusion editors can produce convincing images, but realism or target-classifier flips do not establish that an edit is localized, diagnosis-specific, anatomically faithful, or useful on real clinical data. We introduce PATHEDIT, a state-factorized counterfactual editing framework that decomposes an abdominal CT representation into pathology, anatomy, acquisition, and residual context before performing a clinically specified latent intervention. A pathology editor modifies only the target factor, while non-target factors are explicitly copied and preservation losses penalize collateral drift. The edited state is decoded jointly into an image, a report level description, and diagnostic readouts. Weak supervision from lesion masks, organ segmentations, and naturally occurring longitudinal lesion changes anchors edit direction and spatial support without requiring pixel-aligned counterfactual ground truth. We evaluate four properties that are often conflated in medical image editing: target edit success, non-target preservation, anatomical identity, and real-data utility. In our evaluation protocol, PATHEDIT achieves 94.2% target success while reducing mean off-target diagnostic change to 3.0%, yields substantially stronger alignment with observed lesion changes, and improves rare-lesion recognition and shortcut robustness on held-out real CT. These results motivate astricter view of counterfactual medical imaging: a useful edit must prove not only what changed, but also what did not.
items.summary_zh: PATHEDIT 以病理、解剖、采集与残余状态解耦，实现诊断保持的 CT 反事实编辑。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在留出的真实 CT 上评估了目标编辑、非目标保持、解剖身份和实用性，但其临床决策价值仍须在前瞻性研究中检验。
items.abstract_zh: 反事实医学图像只有在引入所请求的临床变化、且不悄然改变本应保持不变的患者特征时才有用。现有扩散编辑器可以生成逼真的图像，但逼真性或目标分类器翻转并不能证明编辑是局部的、诊断特异的、解剖学忠实的，或对真实临床数据有用。我们提出 PATHEDIT，这是一种状态因子化的反事实编辑框架；它在进行临床指定的潜在干预前，将腹部 CT 表征分解为病理、解剖、采集和残余背景。病理编辑器只修改目标因子，而非目标因子被显式复制，保持损失则惩罚附带漂移。经编辑的状态被联合解码为图像、报告层面的描述和诊断读出。来自病灶掩膜、器官分割和自然发生的纵向病灶变化的弱监督，在无需像素对齐的反事实真值时锚定编辑方向和空间支持。我们评估了医学图像编辑中常被混为一谈的四项属性：目标编辑成功、非目标保持、解剖身份和真实数据实用性。在我们的评估协议中，PATHEDIT 达到 94.2% 的目标成功率，同时将平均非目标诊断变化降至 3.0%；它与观察到的病灶变化具有显著更强的一致性，并提高了留出真实 CT 上罕见病灶识别和捷径鲁棒性。这些结果促成对反事实医学成像更严格的看法：有用的编辑不仅必须证明改变了什么，也必须证明未改变什么。

items.title: SPECTRA: predicting cellular perturbation responses with Graph Learning over Gene Regulatory Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting the transcriptomic consequences of cellular perturbations is challenging due to the sparsity of single-cell transcriptional responses, heterogeneous perturbation efficiency, and the difficulty of identifying the small subset of genes that are truly differentially expressed after perturbation. Current approaches typically encode interventions as latent shifts from unperturbed to perturbed cellular state, making the models hard to interpret. Here we introduce SPECTRA (SPEctral CRISPR Transcriptome Regulatory Autoencoder) a graph-based model that treats CRISPR perturbations as interpretable, localized signals injected into a Gene Regulatory Network and propagated through directed graph neural networks. SPECTRA combines a variational control-cell encoder and a directed heterophilic graph decoder, integrating single-cell expression, pretrained transcriptomic context, and prior regulatory topology into a single node-level representation. We evaluate SPECTRA on a large-scale single-cell CRISPRi benchmark, measuring differentially expressed gene recovery through precision, F1 score, and AUPRC-based DEG classification. Since perturbations in SPECTRA are interpretable, we tested the predictions of the model against known biology, in cases where the effects of a gene knock out have been repeatedly demonstrated with orthogonal experiments. Our results show that graph-based signal propagation is a biologically grounded alternative to latent-shift perturbation modeling and can improve the recovery of sparse perturbation-induced transcriptional effects.
items.summary_zh: SPECTRA 将 CRISPR 扰动作为在基因调控网络中传播的可解释局部信号。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该图模型在大规模单细胞 CRISPRi 基准中评估差异表达基因恢复，并以已知敲除生物学检验解释性。
items.abstract_zh: 由于单细胞转录反应稀疏、扰动效率异质，以及难以识别扰动后真正差异表达的少数基因，预测细胞扰动的转录组后果具有挑战性。现有方法通常将干预编码为从未扰动细胞状态到扰动细胞状态的潜在转移，使模型难以解释。我们在此引入 SPECTRA（SPEctral CRISPR Transcriptome Regulatory Autoencoder），一种基于图的模型：它将 CRISPR 扰动视为注入基因调控网络、并通过有向图神经网络传播的可解释局部信号。SPECTRA 结合变分对照细胞编码器和有向异嗜性图解码器，将单细胞表达、预训练转录组上下文和先验调控拓扑整合为统一的节点层面表征。我们在大规模单细胞 CRISPRi 基准上评估 SPECTRA，通过 precision、F1 score 和基于 AUPRC 的 DEG 分类测量差异表达基因恢复。由于 SPECTRA 中的扰动具有可解释性，我们在基因敲除效应已被正交实验证复现的情形下，将模型预测与已知生物学进行检验。结果显示，基于图的信号传播是潜在转移扰动建模的一种具有生物学依据的替代方案，并可改善对由扰动诱导的稀疏转录效应的恢复。
items.author_line: Calabro M, Sheehan P, Cambuli F, Sottoriva A

items.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals selective vulnerability of cardiac neural crest-derived glial cells in human myocardial infarction
items.abstract_or_text: Cardiac neural crest-derived glial cells (CNGs) are recently identified glial cells that support cardiac autonomic innervation and maintain sympathetic-parasympathetic balance. Their fate in myocardial infarction (MI) is unknown. Here, we analyzed 16 human cardiac spatial transcriptomes spanning normal myocardium (n=4), infarct zone (n=5), border zone (inner, n=1; outer, n=3), and remote zone (n=3). CNGs (S100B+/GFAP+, CD68- spots) were selectively lost along a spatial gradient from healthy tissue to the infarct core (Spearman rho = -0.92, p = 4.5 x 10 -7 ). Tissue-area-corrected analysis confirmed that CNG loss (26% retained in infarct zone vs. normal; p = 0.016) vastly exceeded overall tissue loss, indicating selective vulnerability rather than bulk tissue destruction. Mechanistically, oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) activity in CNG-positive spots correlated positively with CNG survival (partial rho = 0.65, p = 0.009 after controlling for spot composition), consistent with a high metabolic demand underlying their ischemic sensitivity. Pyroptosis - but not ferroptosis or apoptosis - signatures correlated with CNG loss (partial rho = -0.67, p = 0.006). These findings identify CNGs as selectively vulnerable cellular components of the cardiac autonomic system in MI and nominate metabolic failure and pyroptosis as candidate mechanisms, providing a spatially resolved foundation for future mechanistic and interventional studies.
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组提示心脏神经嵴来源胶质细胞在心肌梗死中选择性易损。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 16 份人类心脏空间转录组提出 CNG 缺失、氧化磷酸化和焦亡之间的关联，为后续机制和干预研究提供候选方向，而非因果定论。
items.abstract_zh: 心脏神经嵴来源胶质细胞（CNGs）是近期发现的胶质细胞，支持心脏自主神经支配并维持交感—副交感平衡。它们在心肌梗死（MI）中的命运尚不清楚。我们在此分析了 16 份人类心脏空间转录组，涵盖正常心肌（n=4）、梗死区（n=5）、边缘区（内侧，n=1；外侧，n=3）和远隔区（n=3）。CNGs（S100B+/GFAP+、CD68- spots）沿从健康组织到梗死核心的空间梯度选择性丢失（Spearman rho = -0.92，p = 4.5 × 10^-7）。按组织面积校正的分析证实，CNG 丢失（梗死区相对正常组织保留 26%；p = 0.016）远超过总体组织丢失，表明这是选择性易损性而非整体组织破坏。从机制上看，CNG 阳性 spots 中的氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS）活性与 CNG 存活正相关（控制 spot 组成后 partial rho = 0.65，p = 0.009），这与高代谢需求造成其缺血敏感性一致。焦亡——而非铁死亡或凋亡——特征与 CNG 丢失相关（partial rho = -0.67，p = 0.006）。这些发现将 CNGs 鉴定为 MI 中心脏自主神经系统的选择性易损细胞组分，并提出代谢衰竭和焦亡为候选机制，为未来机制与干预研究提供空间分辨的基础。
items.author_line: Xia X, Ding Y, Zhao X, He Q, Zhang H, Gu Y, Bai H, Pan D
